claims.quote: The CACNA1A gene has been implicated in rare forms of Familial Hemiplegic Migraine (FHM).
The rs10405121 variant was associated with both migraine types, with the homozygous AA genotype exclusively found in familial cases.
Abnormal genotype of rs894252513 and rs1012663275 were detected only in familial cases with MO.
Novel variants may contribute to migraine pathogenesis by altering calcium channel function
